title: Chat Finds The Clip For You
caption:
Chat always reacts after the moment, so this tool rewinds 20 seconds. 🎮💬

TwitchDownloader grabs a stream's whole chat, a script counts the messages every 10 seconds, finds the spike, rewinds, and cuts the clip in vertical. One command, ready for OpenShorts. Claude Code helped build it. Only clip streamers who allow it, and credit them. Not affiliated with any of these tools.

Comment CHAT and tag a friend who clips. Follow @StickMindR8!
